task: CAM-02 NaN camera zoom after server-side exit/re-enter
contract: Goal: parked/anchored vehicles never receive NaN drive forces, and the driving camera never writes a non-finite zoom. Root cause: DrivingClient Heartbeat keeps running for a frame after the server anchors the parked vehicle; anchored AssemblyMass is infinite so every VectorForce becomes NaN, and on re-entry (unanchor) the assembly is thrown to NaN, which DrivingCameraClient latches into CameraMin/MaxZoomDistance. Owners: DrivingClient (drive forces), DrivingCameraClient (zoom/FOV). No new owners, remotes, config, saved data or UI. Preserved: all driving tuning, camera framing/config, exit/park/coast semantics. Done when: API Exit->ReEnter no longer produces NaN forces/position/zoom or BaseCamera/ZoomController clamp errors; normal UI buy/spawn/drive/exit/re-enter/despawn/drive-in flows still work with zoom 22 locked while seated and 0.5/128 restored on foot.
verification: Play: API ExitVehicle/ReEnterVehicle cycles with NaN probe; normal UI spawn/drive/exit/re-enter/despawn; console error scan.
